markdown.markdown:
An **XLSForm** is a normal Excel file (`.xlsx`) written in a special format. KoboToolbox reads it and turns it into a digital form. The rules are the same for KoboToolbox, ODK and other tools, so what you learn here is reusable.

An XLSForm has **three sheets**. The sheet names must be written exactly like this, in lowercase.

::: {.panel-tabset}


One **row per question**. The most important columns:

| Column | Meaning |
|:--|:--|
| `type` | Question type (`integer`, `select_one sex`, `note` …) |
| `name` | Short variable name used in the dataset. Unique, no spaces, starts with a letter (e.g. `age`, `marital_status`) |
| `label` | The question text the respondent sees |
| `hint` | Extra instruction shown under the question |
| `required` | `yes` if the question cannot be skipped |
| `relevant` | Skip logic: when to show the question |
| `constraint` | Allowed values (range check) |
| `constraint_message` | Error message if the value is not allowed |
| `appearance` | How the question looks (`likert`, `multiline`, `field-list` …) |

## choices

One **row per answer option**, linked to `select_one` / `select_multiple` questions by `list_name`.

| list_name | name | label |
|:--|:--|:--|
| sex | male | Male |
| sex | female | Female |
| sex | other | Other |

- `list_name` must match the word after `select_one` in the survey sheet (`select_one sex`).
- `name` is the code saved in your data; `label` is what the respondent sees.

## settings

One row describing the whole form.

| form_title | form_id | version | default_language |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| My thesis survey | my_thesis_survey | 1 | English (en) |

- `form_title`: the title shown on the form.
- `form_id`: unique ID, no spaces.
- `version`: increase it every time you change and re-upload the form.

:::

## A minimal example

**survey**

| type | name | label | required |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| note | intro | Welcome to the study | |
| integer | age | Age in completed years | yes |
| select_one sex | sex | Sex | yes |
| text | comments | Any comments? | |

**choices**

| list_name | name | label |
|:--|:--|:--|
| sex | male | Male |
| sex | female | Female |

## Automatic metadata

Add these rows at the top of every form. They record information automatically, without asking the respondent anything, which is useful for data quality checks.

| type | name | What it records |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `start` | start | When the interview started |
| `end` | end | When the interview ended |
| `today` | today | Date of the interview |
| `deviceid` | deviceid | ID of the phone used |
